featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a very disappointing experience at Hasta Restaurant. The place and ambience are actually good, but unfortunately the staff and management completely ruined the overall experience. First of all, the AC was barely working and the restaurant was feeling hot and uncomfortable throughout the visit. For a restaurant that expects customers to sit and enjoy their meal peacefully, proper cooling is the most basic thing, and they failed badly at that.
The biggest issue was the staff behavior. The restaurant seems extremely understaffed, because there were very few employees handling too many tables. Due to this, service was very slow and unorganized. On top of that, some staff members were very rude and careless while talking to customers. Simple requests had to be repeated multiple times and nobody seemed interested in helping properly.
What made the experience even worse was the manager’s attitude. Complaints regarding the AC and delayed service were ignored completely. The manager was not responding seriously and did not seem to care about customer satisfaction at all. Instead of solving issues, they just avoided responsibility.
Honestly, the hotel and interiors are good, but the staff management is one of the worst I have experienced. Good ambience means nothing if customers are treated poorly and basic comfort is ignored. Very disappointing experience overall and definitely not worth the money or time unless they improve their service, staff behavior, and management.

For me this is not the first time , I am visiting a restaurant,  but for her maybe it is the first time she is operating a restaurant. So Usually while paying the bill , I check for on zomato or dineout , if there is any ongoing offers going, then I pay the bill. So , I checked on zomato there was 15% off offer on the total bill, so we used the offer and paid the bill. The manager or owner don't know who she was came to my brother and asked that did you reserved a sit he said no , then she said that without reservation you can't pay the bill using  the app , she also stated that this a loss for her. This really didn't made any sense to us because the platform zomato is helping her to get the customers with the running offer she applied for on the zomato app. If this she don't want then she should remove that offer thing from the zomato app for the customers that are coming walkin or not doing reservation. customer_updates.name: Naveen Mendan
customer_updates.text:
​I recently headed over to Ravindra Restaurant in Dahisar East for a traditional morning breakfast, and overall, it was a fantastic culinary experience. If you’re looking for authentic flavors to kickstart your day, this place definitely hits the mark.
​We decided to order a spread of classic items to get a real feel for the kitchen’s quality: tea, medu vada, masala uthappam, and the pineapple shera. To put it simply—the food was absolutely delicious. The medu vada was fried to perfection, offering that satisfying crisp exterior with a soft, fluffy center, and the sambar was well-spiced and flavorful. The masala uthappam was equally impressive, packed with fresh vegetables and cooked to just the right texture. The real highlight of the morning, however, was the pineapple shera. It was rich, fragrant, and perfectly balanced in sweetness—truly one of the best I’ve had in a while.
​While the kitchen is clearly doing a great job, the service side of the experience could definitely use some improvement. The restaurant was quite busy, and it felt like the staff was a bit overwhelmed, which led to noticeable delays in getting our order taken and getting the table cleared afterward. A bit more coordination and attentiveness from the service team would really elevate the visit.
​Despite the slow service, the high quality of the food makes Ravindra Restaurant a place I’d gladly visit again. They clearly have a strong handle on their recipes, and it’s a spot I’d recommend to anyone in the area looking for a quality breakfast. I’m hoping that things run a bit smoother on the service front next time, as it would make the entire experience five-star worthy.

featured_reviews.name: Naveen Mendan
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I recently dined at Hotel Ravindra in Dahisar (E), and it was a delightful experience for the palate.

​The Food Experience:
​Paneer Lajawab: This dish truly lived up to its name ("Lajawab" meaning matchless). The gravy was thick, well-textured, and had a perfect balance of tanginess and spice. The paneer cubes were fresh and soft, absorbing the flavors beautifully. It’s a must-order for vegetarians.
​Breads (Butter Naan & Kulcha): You can tell a lot about a kitchen by its tandoor work. The naan and kulchas were served piping hot, glistening with butter, and had that perfect slight crunch on the outside while remaining soft on the inside. The addition of kalonji seeds added a wonderful nutty aroma to every bite.
​Accompaniments: Even the simple additions like the fresh onion rings, lemon, and spicy pickle enhanced the meal significantly. We finished off with a hot tea which was the perfect palate cleanser.
​Ambiance & Service:
The restaurant has a warm, inviting atmosphere suitable for both families and quick dinners. The staff was courteous and the food arrived at our table surprisingly fast.
​The "Water" Hiccup:
The only slight downside to our evening was the coordination regarding drinking water. Despite the staff being polite, we had to request water multiple times before it finally reached the table. In a high-quality dining setup, basic table service like water should ideally be proactive.
​Final Verdict:

Despite the small delay with the water, the culinary experience was top-notch. The flavors are authentic, and the quality of ingredients is evident. I will definitely be returning to try more of their menu!

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Gajera
featured_reviews.review_text:
Parivar Restaurant is one of the best and most trusted family restaurants in Mira Bhayander, and their 20 years of consistent quality truly show why they are so popular. The moment you enter, you feel a warm and welcoming family restaurant vibe. The staff is polite, quick, and always ready to help with recommendations.

We started our meal with Paneer Saate and Veg Shanghai – both were perfectly cooked, soft, and full of flavour. For the main course, we tried the famous Veg Jwalamukhi (spicy, rich gravy with excellent taste) and Paneer Chingari, which was creamy, smoky, and absolutely delicious. We also ordered the Village Pizza, which had a fresh base, good cheese, and a unique Indian-style topping that tasted amazing. To complete the meal, we had Cheese Garlic Naan and Pot Rice, and both were soft, fresh, and served hot.

Considering this place has been serving customers for 20 years in Mira Bhayander, it truly deserves respect for maintaining such great taste and hygiene. Perfect place for family dinners, birthday celebrations, and weekend outings. Highly recommended for anyone looking for tasty vegetarian food and a comfortable dining experience.

featured_reviews.name: Vimall P Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Culinary Journey for the Senses: The Global Veg Treat

In a world where vegetarian dining can sometimes feel repetitive, The Global Veg Treat emerges as a shining beacon of culinary innovation and flavor. This restaurant is not merely a place to eat; it is a destination for those who appreciate the art of plant-based cuisine, and my experience there was nothing short of exceptional.

Let’s start with the most important aspect: the food is an absolute delight. Each dish is a masterclass in flavor, showcasing a thoughtful "global" menu that lives up to its name. From the rich, creamy textures of a perfectly executed Indian paneer makhani to the fresh, zesty notes of a Mediterranean mezze platter, every bite was a journey. The ingredients tasted impeccably fresh, and the complex spice blends demonstrated a kitchen operating at a very high level. It’s the kind of food you crave days after your visit, a true testament to its delicious and memorable quality.

The experience is beautifully complemented by the restaurant's nice ambiance. The interior strikes a perfect balance between cozy and sophisticated, with warm lighting, comfortable seating, and tasteful decor that creates an inviting and relaxed atmosphere. It’s an ideal setting for everything from a quiet, intimate dinner to a celebratory meal with family and friends.

A crucial piece of advice that cannot be overstated: a reservation is absolutely needed. The well-deserved popularity of The Global Veg Treat means that tables are in high demand. Walking in on a whim, especially during weekends, will likely result in a lengthy wait. Planning ahead is a small price to pay for the guaranteed reward of a seamless and wonderful dining experience.

In conclusion, The Global Veg Treat has firmly secured its place as a top-tier vegetarian restaurant. With its sublime food, charming atmosphere, and evident popularity, it delivers on every promise. Do yourself a favor and book a table—your taste buds will thank you.

featured_reviews.name: Cherry
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited this pure vegetarian gem in Dahisar, and I was absolutely impressed! The restaurant boasts a beautiful, aesthetic ambiance paired with a thoughtfully curated global menu. It’s a perfect spot for families, groups, and special celebrations. The hospitality here was warm and welcoming from the moment we walked in.

Must-try Mocktails:
Videshi Kala Khatta – a tangy twist with an international flair
Fruitee Passion – refreshing and packed with tropical notes

Appetisers:
Cheesy Baked Pav Bhaji Fondue – a creative and indulgent spin on a classic
Spicy Steamed Wontons – perfectly spiced, soft and flavorful

Mains:
Qasr-e-Pukhtan – a royal paneer gravy rich in desi ghee, paired beautifully with flaky warqi parathas
Asian Veg Sizzler – generous portions, vibrant, and packed with bold flavors

Dessert:
Baklava with Ice Cream – a delightful fusion that’s an absolute must-try!

Every dish was crafted with so much care and flavor it truly felt like a labor of love. The restaurant also offers various seating sections and is very accessibility-friendly, with a stair chair lift available for elderly guests or anyone with mobility challenges, since it’s located on the first floor .
